description: The transcripts of Kazakh Speech Dataset (KSD). No recipe reads them. Its transcripts are the Kazakh Speech Dataset's JSON files, inside archives that total about 56 GB, and a fetch holds a whole download in memory, so no fetch can read them (see https://github.com/Mearman/keepset/issues/212).
